theme: A travel day with the road mostly to yourself.
greeting: The calendar's clear, Dan — today is a driving day, Fredericksburg down toward the Gulf, with St. Pete waiting Thursday. The open stretch is a good moment to finally clear the holiday-travel bookings before thin inventory decides for you.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority Todoist task — a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week — is about five weeks past its 'book this week' date. A refundable hold costs nothing, and holiday inventory at PWM is the first to disappear.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13 - Jan 2 trip for six was meant to be decided Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15. That book-by date has passed, and holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year.

schedule.title: Drive south, Fredericksburg to St. Pete
schedule.detail: Hotel tonight at Spark by Hilton; Airbnb check-in on Coffee Pot Bayou Thursday.

flagged.title: New SVP Global Public Policy alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a Senior VP of Global Public Policy posting and similar roles this morning.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The Oct 28 event's run of show went out to the group for edits; no reply needed unless something looks off.

flagged.title: St. Pete Airbnb check-in Thursday
flagged.detail: Airbnb reminder confirms the Oct 22 arrival on Coffee Pot Bayou.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail and travel promos, nothing asking for you.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on your reply.

context.location: Fredericksburg, VA - en route to St. Pete

recipe.why: Autumn's winter squash are at their peak sweetness right now.

acts.line: On the road out of Virginia, with no meetings to break the drive.
Miles to cover and an empty calendar to cover them against.
A hotel night in Fredericksburg before the last leg to the Gulf.
